description: Recovery implementation of approved S1: unify live factory submission behind PUT /factory-sessions/{session_id}/factory with explicit save modes (REPLACE_CURRENT default, UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE for named create/replace+activate), remove POST /factories, consolidate backend save pipeline, and migrate dashboard editor, import, CLI, and tests.

context.customerAsk: Retry after network outage. Manual fix may apply to legacy token; this is a fresh idea. Full spec: tasks/prd-session-factory-save-modes.md — Session factory save modes (S1 recovery).
context.problem: Two overlapping factory submission APIs (POST /factories vs session PUT) cause inconsistent validation, persistence roots, and activation. The prior autonomous batch did not complete; the codebase still has POST /factories and bare Factory bodies on session PUT with no save-mode enum.
context.solution: Implement the approved S1 spec: one session PUT with { mode, factory }, default REPLACE_CURRENT, UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE for named upsert+activate, unified backend SaveFactoryForSession pipeline with session-scoped activation only, remove POST /factories, and migrate dashboard editor (replace only), import confirm dialog, CLI live save, and functional tests.

acceptanceCriteria: PUT /factory-sessions/{session_id}/factory accepts { mode?, factory } with default REPLACE_CURRENT and both enum values operational.
POST /factories is removed from OpenAPI, generated clients, UI, CLI live paths, and functional tests.
Backend uses one SaveFactoryForSession pipeline with mode handlers and replaceSessionRuntime-only activation; multi-session tests prove isolation.
Dashboard editor save uses REPLACE_CURRENT only; import confirm offers replace-current vs create-new-named with suffixed name allocation on conflict, session PUT only.
Version rules per mode match approved S1 (REPLACE_CURRENT requires version; UPSERT create may omit; UPSERT replace detects stale on-disk version).
Existing error codes remain mappable for operators (FACTORY_NOT_IDLE, STALE_FACTORY_VERSION, INVALID_FACTORY, etc.).
Quality gate: typecheck, lint, and targeted tests for all changed behavior pass.

userStories.title: Session factory PUT contract and client regeneration
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I need OpenAPI and generated clients to describe save modes on session PUT so all callers share one typed contract.
acceptanceCriteria: PUT /factory-sessions/{session_id}/factory request body includes optional mode enum (REPLACE_CURRENT | UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE) and required factory; omitted mode defaults to REPLACE_CURRENT.
POST /factories is removed from api/openapi.yaml; contract test forbids paths./factories.post.
Bundled spec and generated Go and TypeScript clients are regenerated and compile.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Unified backend save pipeline and mode handlers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need one orchestrated session save pipeline so session-scoped saves never fork through global activation paths.
acceptanceCriteria: FactoryService SaveFactoryForSession implements resolve scope → validate → persist (mode handler) → activate session runtime → readback.

REPLACE_CURRENT requires factory.name to match session current and overwrites current slot; UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE persists under session root, updates current-factory pointer, activates via replaceSessionRuntime only.
HTTP session PUT decodes { mode, factory } and calls only the unified entrypoint; POST /factories handler and CreateNamedFactory / unscoped HTTP SaveCurrentFactory parallel trees are removed.
Service test proves saving session B does not mutate session A for at least one save mode path.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Version rules and error mapping per mode
userStories.description: As a client author, I need deterministic version requirements and response versioning for each save mode.
acceptanceCriteria: REPLACE_CURRENT rejects missing or stale factory.version relative to session current definition.
UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE on create allows omitted factory.version and returns server-minted version in response factory object.
UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE on replace detects stale on-disk version and returns incremented version on success.
UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE does not return FACTORY_ALREADY_EXISTS when replacing an existing named factory while idle.
FACTORY_NOT_IDLE and INVALID_FACTORY still surface for unsafe or invalid payloads.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Dashboard editor save uses REPLACE_CURRENT
userStories.description: As a factory editor, I want Save to update the factory I am editing in the active tab without renaming or switching named factories.
acceptanceCriteria: saveCurrentFactoryDocument and editor save hooks send session PUT with REPLACE_CURRENT (or omitted mode) and factory.version from latest GET.
No editor save path calls UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE or POST /factories.
Stale-version and not-idle errors preserve existing operator-facing messages.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser: editor Save succeeds; stale version shows existing error UX

userStories.title: Dashboard import confirm dialog and mode selection
userStories.description: As a dashboard operator, I want import to offer replace-current vs create-new-named with safe naming when a conflict exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Import activation uses session-scoped PUT only; confirm dialog defaults to Replace current factory.
Replace path sends REPLACE_CURRENT with factory.name from session GET and factory.version from GET; PNG embedded name is ignored.
Create path sends UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE with validated PNG name; allocates first free suffixed name on conflict and shows resolved name before PUT.
Create path omits factory.version for new names; includes version when upserting an existing chosen name.
Replace path never changes the session active factory name including UNDEFINED default root.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser: import on default and non-default session tabs with both dialog choices

Functional tests in tests/functional/runtime_api/factory_transformation and tests/functional/bootstrap_portability use session PUT with explicit mode.
Generated client no longer exposes CreateFactory for POST /factories.
